modules.name: Notice Board and Events
modules.description: Lets Raghuvir and Society Managers publish, schedule, pin, update and cancel posts and events that target users see and are notified about.

requirements.title: Post types
requirements.description: Each new post must be one of Announcement, Celebration, Event or Urgent, on both web and mobile.

requirements.title: Raghuvir post to selected projects
requirements.description: On web, Raghuvir can publish a post to selected projects so that only users of those projects see it.

requirements.title: Society Manager post to own project or buildings
requirements.description: On mobile, a Society Manager with the Post notices permission can post so that only their own project, or selected buildings, sees it.

requirements.title: Show-from and show-until dates
requirements.description: Posts have show-from and show-until dates, and once the show-until date has passed the post moves to Past.

requirements.title: Schedule publish
requirements.description: A post can be given a future publish time, at which it appears and notifies. This is a Should priority on both platforms.

requirements.title: Pin to top
requirements.description: A pinned post stays first on the board. This is a Should priority on both platforms.

requirements.title: Notification on publish
requirements.description: When a post is published, target users receive a notification that opens the post.

requirements.title: Event details
requirements.description: A post of type Event requires date, time and venue.

requirements.title: Notify by age group
requirements.description: When an invited group such as Kids is chosen, the notification goes only to families with kids, while the post remains visible to all in the project. This is a Should priority.

requirements.title: Edit or cancel after publish
requirements.description: When a post is edited or cancelled after publishing, it is marked Updated or Cancelled and target users are notified.

requirements.title: Read-only mobile board
requirements.description: On mobile, any app user sees only their own project's current posts, pinned first and then newest first, with no reply or comment option.
